releases.recording_review: All five Pastoral movements and the complete listed Leonore No.1 track have Klemperer/Philharmonia credits. Warner documents the October1957 Pastoral recording, consistent with target notes and this EMI/Warner reissue family.
limitations: Publisher date evidence concerns the symphony; the overture session date and exact takes are not independently verified.
Matching programme and recording-family support do not establish identical LP/digital mastering.
